evidence_scope: Recorded Resolution to CR to declared target Spec trace; ten requested Spec identities, each supported by an original active agreed-CR witness. Complete34-Spec frontier and original path-count selection are retained with native full2-column evidence.
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber, count(r) AS resolutions ORDER BY resolutions DESC LIMIT 10
question_en: Which specs are modified by CRs approved via resolutions (decision-to-spec trace)?
reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT sp.specNumber, count(r) AS resolutions ORDER BY resolutions DESC LIMIT 10
